description: Erection of a single storey outbuilding following demolition of the shed in the rear garden of the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unreferenced Location Plan; Unreferenced Block Plan; Unreferenced Existing Side Elevation & Plan; Unreferenced Proposed Side Elevation & Plan; Unreferenced Proposed Plan; Unreferenced Proposed Elevations (x4)  Received:  02 June 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be constructed with brick walls, a timber and felt roof and a timber front door.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the outbuilding hereby approved.
Condition : 5 - Any guttering fitted to the outbuilding hereby approved shall not project outside the boundary of the site.

Condition : 6 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the house and for no other purpose.   The outbuilding shall not be used as a self-contained dwelling, or be converted to include a bedroom, kitchen, living room or other primary residential accommodation, or be converted for use as an office for business purposes.
